title: Online Learning with LLM Experts from Limited Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2609.05820v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study adaptive routing of prompts to large language model (LLM) experts to maximize response quality in an online setting with limited feedback. We formulate it as a bandit problem with $K$ actions that represent experts and $d$ features that encode prompts, over a horizon of $T$ rounds. We propose algorithms that strategically select and observe rewards to minimize regret. In the full-information setting, we achieve a regret of $\tilde{O}(d T / \sqrt{m})$, while in the bandit setting we achieve $\tilde{O}(d T \sqrt{K / m})$, where $m \ll T$ is a budget on feedback. Our experiments show that we efficiently learn high-quality routing strategies across diverse LLMs from limited feedback.

translated_title: 基于有限反馈的LLM专家在线学习
translated_abstract: 我们研究在有限反馈的在线环境中，如何自适应地将提示路由到大语言模型（LLM）专家以最大化响应质量。我们将其表述为一个老虎机问题，其中$K$个动作代表专家，$d$个特征对提示进行编码，时间范围为$T$轮。我们提出了策略性地选择和观察奖励以最小化遗憾的算法。在完全信息设置下，我们实现了$\tilde{O}(dT/\sqrt{m})$的遗憾，而在老虎机设置下我们实现了$\tilde{O}(dT\sqrt{K/m})$的遗憾，其中$m \ll T$是反馈预算。我们的实验表明，我们能够从有限反馈中高效地学习跨多样化LLM的高质量路由策略。
tldr: 该论文提出了在有限反馈预算下将提示自适应路由到LLM专家的在线学习算法，在完全信息设置和老虎机设置下分别实现了$\tilde{O}(dT/\sqrt{m})$和$\tilde{O}(dT\sqrt{K/m})$的遗憾界，能够高效学习高质量的LLM路由策略。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes online learning algorithms for adaptively routing prompts to LLM experts under limited feedback budgets, achieving regret bounds of $\tilde{O}(dT/\sqrt{m})$ in the full-information setting and $\tilde{O}(dT\sqrt{K/m})$ in the bandit setting, enabling efficient learning of high-quality LLM routing strategies.
